Keep the exact complete footprint and generous empty border. The exact approved source image overrides any verbal identity description. Preserve the pale plain bed floor with its two small rectangular brackets; NO new cross-brace, X or bone-shaped object. Preserve the hood red chevron and yellow hazard markings as contrasting identity patches, including during livery edits.
